title: Zesty Slovakian Doughnuts Pancakes
description: A sweet and tangy dessert featuring jammy, aerated Slovakian doughnuts topped with a refreshing lemon glaze and colorful candy.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

ingredients.name: 1 large egg replacement
ingredients.notes: such as flax or mashed banana

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the non-dairy milk, egg replacement, lemon juice, canola oil, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the doughnuts and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Dust the doughnuts with granulated sugar while still warm.
Drizzle the lemon glaze over the doughnuts.
